caveats: These are historical reproductions that assert the observed defects, not permanent passing regression tests.
SSE probe uses a valid two-second signed fixture cookie to exercise the same expiry validation as the normal twelve-hour cookie.
Redirect probe requires a redirect from the configured backend or its proxy; it is not an unauthenticated localhost exploit.
PTN timeout uses a 91-second provider delay with the actual client timeout and real HTTP/route handling; it does not measure live provider latency.
Native diagnostic reruns alter test-app environment only. They do not establish that the unmodified smoke suite passes.
Skipped platform tests were not claimed as executed. No native Linux/macOS rerun, full multiplayer deployment or in-game reward audit was performed.
The existing partial-engineering issue 111 is reconfirmed; no duplicate issue should be created.
